description: Official isothermal circularly polarised Alfven wave family from cpaw.py: right-polarised at nx=128 and nx=256 and left-polarised (dir=2) at nx=256, uniform mesh.
deck_delta:
--- code/athena/inputs/mhd/athinput.cpaw2d
+++ config/athinput.cpaw2d
@@ -7,13 +7,19 @@
 problem_id = cpaw      # problem ID: basename of output filenames
 
 <output1>
-file_type  = hst       # History data dump
-dt         = 0.1      # time increment between outputs
+file_type   = hst       # history dump: volume-integrated conserved totals
+dt          = 0.1
+data_format = %25.17e  # full-precision (round-trip) formatted output
 
 <output2>
-file_type  = vtk       # Binary data dump
-variable   = prim      # variables to be output
-dt         = 0.01      # time increment between outputs
+file_type   = tab       # formatted table, one file per MeshBlock
+variable    = prim
+dt          = 0.1
+data_format = %25.17e
+
+<output3>
+file_type   = rst       # native restart checkpoint: conserved state + face-centred B
+dt          = 0.1
 
 <time>
 cfl_number = 0.4       # The Courant, Friedrichs, & Lewy (CFL) Number
@@ -67,4 +73,3 @@
 v_par   = 0.0         # vpar = {0, 1} -> {traveling, standing} wave
 ang_2   = 0.0         # rotation of k around x2 axis
 dir     = 1           # 1: right polarization (whistler wave), 2: left
-
scientific_status: Provisional exact-identity self-wiring policy: a candidate passes only by bit-identical state, native face-field, div-B, conservation, history and error-file evidence against the trusted CPU oracle, with every rewarded observable reparsed by the verifier from the run's own retained native bytes. Face fields are native restart-checkpoint values (b.x1f/x2f/x3f), not cell-centre averages. Final tolerances, div-B/conservation limits and parallel-determinism policy are Jason-owned and remain pending; nothing here is a scientific pass claim.
declared_subcases_not_executed: mesh/refinement=static variant of the upstream script (not executed here)
upstream error/convergence thresholds are not applied (owner-pending)
human_decisions: Final tolerances, div-B and conservation limits, cross-run/cross-build determinism policy for the parallel variants, static-refinement inclusion and coarse/fine interface treatment, retention and weighting of the legacy witnesses, the selected upstream subcase bundle and the check-local deck derivatives remain Jason-owned decisions; every slot is an explicit null and the verifier fails closed (exact identity only) until they are set.
